protocol.evaluation: 2026 games available through frozen input snapshot
protocol.model: Exact current xG90 prior2 at causal decision clocks, market mixing excluded from model calibration
protocol.method: Single multiclass power temperature alpha in [0.5,2], optimized on training log loss. No per-league coefficients or model search.
protocol.promotion: Evaluation multiclass log loss and Brier both decrease; weekly block bootstrap95% upper bound of log-loss difference below zero; xG-covered evaluation subgroup must not worsen either metric.
protocol.limitations: 2026 outcomes already inspected in earlier unrelated research. Train contains no xG available at its actual observation clocks. This is a temporal holdout, not untouched prospective evidence. No historical bookmaker-calibration claim.
